mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Settlement (publisher_id, settlement_month, total_amount, status) VALUES (#{publisher_id}, #{settlement_month}, #{total_amount}, 'READY')
mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id, s.publisher_id, s.settlement_month, s.total_amount, s.status, p.name AS publisher_name, ROUND(s.total_amount * 1.35) AS total_purchase_amount FROM Settlement s JOIN Publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.publisher_id ORDER BY s.settlement_month DESC, s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT s.settlement_id, s.publisher_id, s.settlement_month, s.total_amount, s.status, p.name AS publisher_name, ROUND(s.total_amount * 1.35) AS total_purchase_amount FROM Settlement s JOIN Publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.publisher_id WHERE s.settlement_month = #{settlement_month} ORDER BY s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT (SELECT NVL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM Customer_Order WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS totalRevenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer_Order WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS newOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer_Order WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Inventory WHERE current_stock <= safety_stock) AS lowStockCount,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM Customer_Order WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'Q') = '1') AS q1Revenue, (SELECT NVL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM Customer_Order WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'Q') = '2') AS q2Revenue, (SELECT NVL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM Customer_Order WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'Q') = '3') AS q3Revenue, (SELECT NVL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM Customer_Order WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND TO_CHAR(order_date, 'Q') = '4') AS q4Revenue FROM DUAL

SELECT ROWNUM AS rank, A.* FROM ( SELECT b.title AS book_title, 'IT / 개발' AS category, p.name AS publisher_name, SUM(oi.qty) AS total_sales_qty FROM Order_Item oi JOIN Customer_Order co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id JOIN Book b ON oi.book_id = b.book_id JOIN Publisher p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id WHERE co.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY b.title, p.name ORDER BY total_sales_qty DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT s.settlement_id, s.publisher_id, s.settlement_month, s.total_amount, s.status, p.name AS publisher_name, ROUND(s.total_amount * 1.35) AS total_purchase_amount FROM Settlement s JOIN Publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.publisher_id WHERE s.settlement_month = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY s.settlement_id DESC
